```yaml
name: Sync AI Connector Docs

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 */6 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  sync-docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout airbytehq/airbyte-agent-connectors
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
        with:
          repository: airbytehq/airbyte-agent-connectors
          path: airbyte-agent-connectors

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Copy AI connector docs
        run: |
          mkdir -p docs/ai-agents/connectors
          find airbyte-agent-connectors -type f -name "*.md" -exec cp {} docs/ai-agents/connectors/ \;

      - name: Create PR
        id: create-pr
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          title: "Sync AI Connector Docs"
          body: "Automatically synced AI connector documentation."
          head: ${{ github.repository }}:sync-ai-docs
          base: main
          labels: documentation,auto-merge
          reviewers: ian-at-airbyte
          assignees: ian-at-airbyte

      - name: Enable auto-merge
        if: steps.create-pr.outputs.pull_request_number != ''
        uses: peter-evans/enable-pull-request-automerge@v3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.OCTAVIA_BOT_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          repository: ${{ github.repository }}
          pull-request-number: ${{ steps.create-pr.outputs.pull_request_number }}
          merge-method: squash

  cleanup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: sync-docs
    steps:
      - name: Clean up temporary checkout
        run: rm -rf airbyte-agent-connectors
```
